summary: Revokes are confirmed, new accounts no longer fail runs, and Pending changes and times are easier to read.

fixes.title: A revoke is checked, not assumed
fixes.text: A sign-in session revoke is now confirmed instead of recorded as not verifiable. A revoke for an account deleted in the meantime now completes as done.

fixes.title: New accounts no longer fail the run
fixes.text: A role given to an account created minutes earlier is now shown as waiting and applied on the next run, instead of failing the whole run.

fixes.title: Pending changes says what a change is
fixes.text: Each changed row leads with its name, and a group deletion says it will be deleted in Entra ID on the next run.

fixes.title: Times are shown correctly
fixes.text: Queued changes could show times hours off. Every time is now shown in one format in UTC.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The Home permission banner no longer hangs, screens use the menu's names, help text is readable, and a first deployment into an empty tenant no longer looks stuck.
